findings.evidence: When you register an account on TED.com, we ask you to provide a unique email address, first and last name, and password. You have the option of also providing profile information (such as location, occupation and your personal story). You may also choose to directly send us information such as email correspondence or search queries.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that contact details are shared with Mixpanel or any other third party.
